title: A Salt for the Spire
author: Gideon Marchetti
blurb: Sebastian Almeida, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
